metadata.name: kernel-zero-workflow-policy
metadata.description: Deterministic GitHub Actions workflow hygiene rules for the KERNEL ZERO repository.

rules.title: Actions are pinned
rules.remediation: Reference every action by an immutable ref; switch this rule to sha mode once every action is pinned to a commit.

rules.title: Least-privilege permissions
rules.remediation: Declare top-level permissions and grant write only to scopes this policy lists.
